Basic_DataTable.name: Data Table
Basic_DataTable.description: A word data table exactly as it appears in a Word document: one semantic HTML table element (thead + tbody, tr/th/td) styled like a word-processor table - simple borders, a bold header row, plain text cells holding reference data in rows and columns. Display only - no buttons, no sorting, no filters, no interaction of any kind.

schema.title: Data Table
schema.description: A display-only word-processor style data table with a caption, bold header row, and plain-text body rows.

caption.description: Optional table caption shown above the table, e.g. the dataset title.

headers.description: Column header labels rendered as th cells in a thead row.

rows.description: Body rows; each row is an array of plain-text cell values aligned to headers.

footnote.description: Optional small source note shown under the table.

highlightColumn.description: Optional zero-based index of a column to subtly emphasize (e.g. the dependent variable). Omit for none.

Basic_TextBlock.name: Normal Text Block
Basic_TextBlock.description: Normal text block with fonts and sizes: headings, paragraphs and emphasis — the readable prose primitive of a lesson.

schema.title: Normal Text Block
schema.description: Readable prose primitive: headings, paragraphs and inline emphasis.

eyebrow.description: Optional small overline label rendered above the title (e.g. a unit or skill tag).

title.description: Main heading of the block (h2).

subtitle.description: Optional secondary line under the title (h3).

sections.description: Ordered list of content sections, each with an optional heading and one or more paragraphs.

paragraphs.description: One or more paragraphs of prose. Supports inline markdown-style emphasis: **bold**, *italic*, `code`.

Basic_VennDiagram.name: Venn Diagram
Basic_VennDiagram.description: A static two-circle Venn diagram with labeled regions showing where two groups overlap.

schema.title: Venn Diagram
schema.description: A static two-circle Venn diagram with labeled regions showing where two groups overlap.

title.description: Heading shown above the diagram.

subtitle.description: Optional secondary line under the title (e.g. the lesson context).

leftLabel.description: Name of the first group, rendered over the left circle.

rightLabel.description: Name of the second group, rendered over the right circle.

leftItems.description: Traits unique to the left group (left-only region).

rightItems.description: Traits unique to the right group (right-only region).

sharedItems.description: Traits shared by both groups (overlap region).

leftRegionLabel.description: Optional short region caption for the left-only crescent.

rightRegionLabel.description: Optional short region caption for the right-only crescent.

sharedRegionLabel.description: Optional short region caption for the overlap.

caption.description: Optional note or takeaway shown beneath the diagram.

Basic_Steps.name: Steps Block
Basic_Steps.description: A numbered steps block laying a short procedure out in order.

schema.title: Steps Block
schema.description: A numbered steps block laying a short procedure out in order.

title.description: Optional heading shown above the steps.

subtitle.description: Optional secondary line under the title.

steps.description: The procedure's steps, in the order they should be carried out.

label.description: Optional short bold lead-in for the step, e.g. 'Isolate the variable'.

text.description: The step's instruction text.

detail.description: Optional supporting sentence shown in secondary text.

Hook_Dilemma.name: Hook Dilemma
Hook_Dilemma.description: Split-card presenting two conflicting, plausible real-world choices to spark curiosity.

schema.title: Hook Dilemma
schema.description: Split-card presenting two conflicting, plausible real-world choices to spark curiosity. Display-only.

eyebrow.description: Optional small uppercase label above the prompt (e.g. unit name or 'Warm-Up Dilemma').

prompt.description: The dilemma question or scenario presented across both cards.

context.description: Optional short supporting paragraph under the prompt that frames the stakes.

label.description: Short tag for the option (e.g. 'OPTION A').

title.description: Headline for the choice.

tone.description: Optional accent color hint for this card's edge.

label.description: Short tag for the option (e.g. 'OPTION B').

title.description: Headline for the choice.

tone.description: Optional accent color hint for this card's edge.

versusLabel.description: Optional short text shown at the divider between the cards (e.g. 'VS').

footerNote.description: Optional closing line beneath the split cards.

Hook_StatShock.name: Hook StatShock
Hook_StatShock.description: Single massive typographic statistic card with context revealing an unexpected reality.

schema.title: Hook StatShock
schema.description: A single massive typographic statistic card that reveals an unexpected reality through one number and its context.

eyebrow.description: Short kicker line above the number, e.g. 'By the numbers' or 'Did you know?'. Optional.

statistic.description: The massive hero figure or short numeric phrase, e.g. '1 in 3' or '12%'. Displayed oversized.

unit.description: Optional small unit or qualifier appended beside the statistic, e.g. 'of Americans' or 'per decade'. May be omitted.

caption.description: One to three lines directly under the number explaining what it counts — the 'what am I looking at' line.

context.description: The unexpected-reality paragraph: one or two sentences that reframe the statistic into a surprise, a claim, or a question to sit with. Optional but recommended.

source.description: Attribution / study / publication name shown as fine print at the bottom. Optional.

accent.description: Accent color name used for the hero figure. One of 'sky' (default), 'success', 'caution', 'misconception', 'slate'. Optional.

contrastLabel.description: Optional short label for the comparison figure (e.g. 'What most people guess').

contrastValue.description: Optional comparison figure shown alongside the hero statistic for contrast (e.g. '45%'). Renders only when contrastLabel is also present.

Hook_QuoteDissect.name: Hook QuoteDissect
Hook_QuoteDissect.description: Historic or expert quote with highlighted buzzwords and clickable annotations.

schema.title: Hook Quote Dissect
schema.description: A historic or expert quote with highlighted buzzwords and clickable annotations.

quote.description: The full quote text. Spans marked with double square brackets, e.g. 'We are the [[hollow men]]', will be turned into tappable buzzword tokens.

speaker.description: Name of the person who said or wrote the quote.

source.description: Citation line: work title, venue, date or context.

epigraph.description: Optional small kicker shown above the quote (era, unit, framing line).

buzzwords.description: One entry per highlighted span in the quote, in order of appearance.

term.description: The exact text highlighted in the quote.

label.description: Short gloss shown on the chip (defaults to term when omitted).

annotation.description: The teaching note revealed when the term is tapped.

prompt.description: Optional one-line instruction shown above the quote (e.g. 'Tap each highlighted term').

instructionLabel.description: Optional short label for the interaction affordance footer.

Theory_RuleCard.name: Theory RuleCard
Theory_RuleCard.description: Clean definition box with a bolded 1-sentence anchor and 3 prerequisite bullet points.

schema.title: Theory_RuleCard
schema.description: A static definition card: one bolded anchor sentence plus prerequisite bullet points. No interactive controls.

ruleName.description: Short title of the rule or theorem shown at the top of the card.

anchor.description: The single-sentence bolded anchor definition shown prominently.

prerequisites.description: Three (or more) prerequisite bullet points the learner should already know.

tag.description: Optional small eyebrow/label rendered above the rule name (e.g. 'Mechanics', 'Close Reading').

Theory_ContrastSplit.name: Theory ContrastSplit
Theory_ContrastSplit.description: Side-by-side comparison column (e.g., "What it is" vs. "What it isn't").

schema.title: Theory ContrastSplit
schema.description: Side-by-side comparison columns contrasting what a concept is versus what it is not.

title.description: Heading for the contrast split, naming the concept under comparison.

subtitle.description: Optional one-line framing beneath the title.

tone.description: Optional status accent for the column; defaults to accent.

label.description: Optional short bold lead-in for the item.

text.description: The comparison point body text.

heading.description: Column heading, e.g. 'What it is NOT'.

tone.description: Optional status accent for the column; defaults to caution.

label.description: Optional short bold lead-in for the item.

text.description: The contrast point body text.

footnote.description: Optional closing takeaway line rendered beneath both columns.

Theory_AnatomyCallout.name: Theory AnatomyCallout
Theory_AnatomyCallout.description: SVG/diagram schematic where hovering or tapping parts reveals breakdown cards.

schema.title: Theory AnatomyCallout
schema.description: An interactive SVG schematic where hovering, tapping or keyboard-focusing a labeled part reveals its breakdown card. All subject content is supplied through data.

title.description: Accessible title for the diagram (also the SVG aria-label).

caption.description: Optional caption rendered beneath the diagram.

labels.description: Optional chrome strings for the block's own UI.

exampleLabel.description: Header text for the example strip inside a breakdown card (e.g. 'Example').

pickerAria.description: aria-label for the part-picker chip group.

emptyHint.description: Fallback text shown if no part is selected.

diagram.description: The SVG schematic geometry and its hotspot marks.

viewBox.description: SVG viewBox string, e.g. '0 0 400 300'. Defaults to '0 0 400 300'.

marks.description: Drawn hotspots; each mark must reference a part id.

id.description: Part id this mark reveals (must match a parts[].id).

stroke.description: Override stroke color for the hotspot outline.

fill.description: Override fill color for the hotspot.

label.description: On-diagram label text for this part.

labelAnchor.description: text-anchor for the label (start | middle | end).

parts.description: Ordered breakdown cards, one per anatomical part of the theory/diagram.

id.description: Stable id linking this card to its diagram marks.

label.description: Human-readable name of the part.

role.description: Short functional tag, e.g. 'Appeal to logic'.

description.description: Concise breakdown of what the part does.

example.description: A concrete worked example or quotation illustrating the part.

Theory_FormulaBuilder.name: Theory FormulaBuilder
Theory_FormulaBuilder.description: Visual equation box where variables have color-coded definitions underneath.

schema.title: Theory FormulaBuilder
schema.description: Visual equation box where variables have color-coded definitions underneath.

title.description: Optional heading shown above the equation box.

subtitle.description: Optional secondary line under the title.

formula.description: The equation itself, tokenized so each variable can carry its own color.

label.description: Small caption rendered above the equation, e.g. 'Newton's second law'.

ariaLabel.description: Accessible spoken form of the equation for screen readers.

tokens.description: Ordered token list. Operators/whitespace use kind 'op' or 'space'; variables use kind 'variable' and may repeat.

text.description: Glyph shown in the equation (e.g. 'F', '=', '+').

ref.description: Key into 'variables' linking this glyph to its definition. Required for kind 'variable'.

variables.description: Color-coded definitions rendered underneath the equation box.

symbol.description: Large symbol glyph shown in the definition chip.

unit.description: SI unit or unit expression, e.g. 'N (kg·m/s²)'.

color.description: Optional CSS color override for this variable's accent.

note.description: Optional short caution or extra nuance.

footnote.description: Optional closing line below the definitions, e.g. sign-convention reminder.

Theory_TimelineSteps.name: Theory TimelineSteps
Theory_TimelineSteps.description: Horizontal or vertical milestone progression showing chronological or logic order.

schema.title: Theory TimelineSteps
schema.description: A milestone progression showing chronological or logic order. Static display: no inputs.

title.description: Optional heading shown above the timeline.

subtitle.description: Optional secondary line under the title.

orientation.description: Layout axis. 'auto' switches to vertical below 640px.

accent.description: Optional CSS color overriding the default accent for markers/connectors.

marker.description: Short marker text rendered in the node (e.g. year, step number).

label.description: Milestone name — the primary text.

emphasis.description: Optional visual emphasis for this milestone.

Theory_TaxonomyTree.name: Theory TaxonomyTree
Theory_TaxonomyTree.description: Collapsible node hierarchy classifying concepts from broad family to specific instance.

schema.title: Theory TaxonomyTree
schema.description: Collapsible node hierarchy classifying concepts from broad family to specific instance.

title.description: Heading shown above the taxonomy tree.

subtitle.description: Optional secondary line placed under the title.

expandLabel.description: Optional accessible label prefix for the expand/collapse toggles.

label.description: Concept name shown in the node row.

note.description: Optional short descriptor shown beside or under the label.

rank.description: Optional taxonomy rank badge, e.g. Family, Genus, Species, Instance.

detail.description: Optional longer explanatory text shown when the node is present.

defaultOpen.description: Whether this branch starts expanded (parents default to expanded if omitted).

children.description: Optional child nodes forming the next level of the hierarchy.

Theory_PerspectiveShift.name: Theory PerspectiveShift
Theory_PerspectiveShift.description: Tabbed card showing how two different stakeholders view the exact same event.

schema.title: Theory PerspectiveShift
schema.description: Tabbed card showing how two different stakeholders view the exact same event.

eventLabel.description: Short name of the shared event (e.g. a headline or scene reference).

eventSummary.description: One or two neutral sentences describing the exact event both stakeholders witnessed.

eventQuote.description: Optional neutral excerpt of the event text itself, shown as a quoted strip.

perspectives.description: Two to four stakeholder viewpoints on the same event.

stakeholder.description: Who is speaking, shown as the tab label (e.g. 'Marlow', 'Kurtz's Intended').

roleTag.description: Optional short role line under the stakeholder name (e.g. 'riverboat captain').

viewpoint.description: How this stakeholder interprets the event.

evidence.description: Optional quotation or concrete detail supporting the viewpoint.

keyPhrase.description: Optional short phrase this stakeholder would use for the event.

lens.description: Optional interpretive lens label (e.g. 'imperial idealism', 'survivor guilt').

accentTone.description: Optional status accent for this tab: neutral (cyan), caution (amber), success (green), error (red).

footerNote.description: Optional closing line beneath the card (e.g. a synthesis prompt or author's craft note).

Memory_MnemonicAnchor.name: Memory MnemonicAnchor
Memory_MnemonicAnchor.description: Visual badge isolating an acronym, rhyme, or spatial pattern to aid memory.

schema.title: Mnemonic Anchor Badge
schema.description: Visual badge isolating an acronym, rhyme, or spatial pattern to aid memory. Static display block — no interactive controls.

mnemonicType.description: Kind of mnemonic being isolated. Controls the badge glyph and small type label.

title.description: Short heading shown above the badge (e.g. the memory device's name or the skill it serves).

anchor.description: The mnemonic itself — the letters, rhyme line, or spatial cue to be memorised. Required.

subtitle.description: Optional one-line gloss under the anchor (e.g. what the mnemonic stands for).

expansions.description: Optional list of what each letter / beat / position stands for, rendered as a labelled strip beneath the badge.

letter.description: The letter, beat, or step marker.

phrase.description: The word or phrase that marker expands to.

rationale.description: Optional short explanation of why this mnemonic works / when to reach for it.

categoryLabel.description: Optional small eyebrow label (e.g. skill family, unit, or tag).

accent.description: Optional accent tone for the badge border/glow. Defaults to the primary cyan.

Memory_CheatSheet.name: Memory CheatSheet
Memory_CheatSheet.description: Compact key-value matrix summarizing all relevant rules for reference.

schema.title: Memory CheatSheet
schema.description: Compact key-value matrix summarizing all relevant rules for quick reference. Display-only.

title.description: Heading shown at the top of the cheat sheet.

subtitle.description: Optional secondary line beneath the title, e.g. the unit or topic.

rows.description: The key-value matrix, rendered in order.

key.description: The rule, term or concept name.

value.description: The statement, formula or reminder paired with the key.

detail.description: Optional compact footnote under the value.

tone.description: Optional accent for the row key: 'default' | 'success' | 'caution' | 'error' | 'accent'.

Context_HistoricalPivot.name: Context HistoricalPivot
Context_HistoricalPivot.description: Short story card showing the exact crisis or problem that caused the rule to be invented.

schema.title: Context_HistoricalPivot
schema.description: A short story card showing the exact crisis or historical problem that caused a rule, formula, or convention to be invented.

title.description: Headline of the story card.

ruleName.description: The name of the rule/convention that was invented.

era.description: Time/place stamp for the pivot moment (e.g. 'London, 1840s').

crisis.description: Short description of the crisis or problem that forced the invention.

story.description: One or more short narrative paragraphs telling the story of the pivot moment, in order.

turningPoint.description: The decisive moment or decision that produced the rule.

beforeAfter.description: Optional side-by-side contrast of life before and after the rule.

before.description: How things worked (or failed) before the rule.

after.description: How things worked once the rule existed.

takeaway.description: One-line takeaway tying the historical crisis back to the modern rule.

figure.description: Optional inline SVG-style figure drawn from geometry primitives (no external images).

bars.description: Labeled magnitude bars to render (e.g. ship losses per year).

tags.description: Optional small tag chips for cross-referencing the lesson.

Context_RealWorldScope.name: Context RealWorldScope
Context_RealWorldScope.description: Micro-case study illustrating where this rule directly affects money, safety, or code.

schema.title: Context RealWorldScope
schema.description: A static micro-case study card showing where a rule directly affects money, safety, or code.

ruleName.description: The name of the rule, concept, or idea the micro-case grounds.

domain.description: Which real-world axis the micro-case touches: money, safety, or code. Drives the accent icon and label.

headline.description: Short, punchy headline for the micro-case (one line, ideally under 70 characters).

caseText.description: The micro-case narrative: 2-4 short paragraphs of plain text (newlines preserved) describing a real moment where the rule changes an outcome.

stakesLabel.description: Optional short badge naming the concrete stake (e.g. '$1.2M contract', 'patient dosing', '99.99% uptime').

label.description: What the value measures, e.g. 'of hospital medication errors trace to this rule'.

tone.description: Optional tone for the metric accent. Defaults to caution.

consequenceMissed.description: Optional one-sentence description of what goes wrong when the rule is ignored.

consequenceApplied.description: Optional one-sentence description of what goes right when the rule is applied.

sourceNote.description: Optional short attribution or provenance line rendered small at the bottom.

tags.description: Optional small keyword chips (max 6 shown) for cross-linking the case in a unit map.

Concept_ScaleZoom.name: Concept ScaleZoom
Concept_ScaleZoom.description: Stepped slider zooming from micro view to macro ecosystem view.

schema.title: Concept ScaleZoom
schema.description: Stepped slider zooming from a micro view to a macro ecosystem view. Every label, step and caption arrives through data.

title.description: Heading shown above the zoom instrument.

subtitle.description: Short secondary line under the heading (optional).

unitLabel.description: Word used for one stop on the scale, e.g. 'scale' or 'order of magnitude'.

steps.description: Ordered zoom stops, from most micro to most macro.

label.description: Short name of this scale stop, e.g. 'Chloroplast'.

scale.description: The size/extent shown at this stop, e.g. '~5 µm' (optional).

caption.description: One or two sentence description of what is visible at this stop.

metric.description: Compact numeric readout chip, e.g. '1 cell' or '10^3 organisms' (optional).

accent.description: Status accent for this stop's chip/glyph (optional, default primary).

startIndex.description: Zero-based index of the initially selected stop (optional, default 0).

Concept_JargonBuster.name: Concept JargonBuster
Concept_JargonBuster.description: Sentence with underlined technical terms that reveal plain-English definitions on hover.

schema.title: Concept JargonBuster
schema.description: A sentence with underlined technical terms that reveal plain-English definitions on hover (or tap on touch devices).

eyebrow.description: Small overline label rendered above the sentence (e.g. a unit or skill name). Optional.

heading.description: Short heading rendered above the sentence. Optional.

sentence.description: The display sentence. Any term whose key appears in 'terms' is written as {key} and is replaced by an underlined, definition-revealing token. Curly braces that do not match a term key are shown literally.

terms.description: The technical terms embedded in the sentence.

label.description: The surface form of the term as it should appear in the sentence (may include inflection, e.g. 'osmosis').

hint.description: Optional short gloss appended to the definition (e.g. an example or analogy).

footer.description: Optional closing line rendered below the sentence in secondary text.

Concept_BeforeAfter.name: Concept BeforeAfter
Concept_BeforeAfter.description: Interactive split image/text card comparing a raw flawed state to an optimized state.

schema.title: Concept Before/After
schema.description: Interactive split image/text card comparing a raw flawed state to an optimized state. The learner drags (or taps) a divider to reveal before vs after; both sides carry a label, a title and a short text.

conceptTitle.description: Heading naming the concept being compared (e.g. 'Weak vs. Refined Thesis').

conceptSubtitle.description: Optional short line under the heading giving context for the comparison.

prompt.description: Optional instruction line telling the learner what to look for while sweeping the divider.

before.description: The raw / flawed state shown on the left side.

label.description: Short badge label for this state, e.g. 'Before' or 'Draft'.

title.description: Name of the state, e.g. 'Unfocused Thesis'.

body.description: The raw text, prose or description shown on this side.

points.description: Optional short bullet observations about this state (up to 4).

tone.description: Accent tone for this side. Defaults to 'error' for before.

artKind.description: Optional procedural visual motif rendered behind/above the text: prose blocks, uneven line strokes, uneven bars, noisy wave, scattered points, or a fine grid.

artData.description: Optional numeric series (0..1) driving the bars/wave/scatter motif so lessons can show real data shapes.

caption.description: Optional small caption under the visual.

after.description: The optimized / refined state shown on the right side.

label.description: Short badge label for this state, e.g. 'After' or 'Revised'.

title.description: Name of the refined state.

body.description: The refined text, prose or description shown on this side.

points.description: Optional short bullet observations about the refined state (up to 4).

tone.description: Accent tone for this side. Defaults to 'success' for after.

artKind.description: Optional procedural visual motif for the refined state.

artData.description: Optional numeric series (0..1) driving the bars/wave/scatter motif.

caption.description: Optional small caption under the visual.

dividerStart.description: Optional initial divider position as percent from the left (default 50).

footerNote.description: Optional closing takeaway line shown beneath the split card.

Concept_PrincipleMatrix.name: Concept PrincipleMatrix
Concept_PrincipleMatrix.description: 2x2 grid sorting ideas by two axes (e.g., High Impact vs. Low Effort).

schema.title: Concept Principle Matrix
schema.description: A static 2x2 matrix display that sorts ideas into four quadrants defined by two perpendicular axes. Display-only: renders its content and stops.

title.description: Heading shown above the matrix.

subtitle.description: Optional secondary line under the title, e.g. the classroom context.

axes.description: Labels for the two sorting dimensions.

horizontal.description: Label for the left-to-right axis, e.g. 'Effort'.

vertical.description: Label for the bottom-to-top axis, e.g. 'Impact'.

quadrants.description: Exactly four quadrant definitions covering the 2x2 grid.

id.description: Stable identifier for the quadrant, e.g. 'high-impact-low-effort'.

label.description: Short quadrant name, e.g. 'Quick Wins'.

tone.description: Optional status accent for the quadrant header. Defaults to 'accent'.

text.description: The idea as it should read in the quadrant.

note.description: Optional one-line rationale or citation for the idea.

footnote.description: Optional closing note rendered beneath the matrix.

Concept_SpectrumBar.name: Concept SpectrumBar
Concept_SpectrumBar.description: Continuous gradient bar pinning concepts along a spectrum (e.g., Informal to Formal).

schema.title: Concept_SpectrumBar
schema.description: A continuous gradient bar that pins labeled concepts along a spectrum between two poles.

id.description: Optional identifier for this spectrum instance.

title.description: Heading shown above the spectrum.

subtitle.description: Optional secondary line under the title.

leftPole.description: Label for the left end of the spectrum.

rightPole.description: Label for the right end of the spectrum.

gradient.description: Optional gradient endpoints as CSS colors for the bar background.

pinColor.description: Optional CSS color used for concept pins and labels.

concepts.description: Concepts pinned along the bar, each with a position 0 (left pole) to 1 (right pole).

id.description: Optional stable id for the concept.

label.description: Short name of the concept.

description.description: Optional short descriptor shown in the legend.

position.description: Position along the bar from 0 to 1.

accent.description: Optional CSS color override for this concept's pin.

legendCaption.description: Optional caption heading for the legend list below the bar.

Concept_AudioWave.name: Concept AudioWave
Concept_AudioWave.description: Short audio player paired with synced sentence highlights for pronunciation or rhetoric.

schema.title: Concept AudioWave
schema.description: A short audio player paired with synchronized sentence-level highlights for pronunciation or rhetorical delivery practice.

title.description: Optional display title for the audio block, e.g. 'MLK — 'I Have a Dream', paragraph 9'.

subtitle.description: Optional secondary label such as speaker, source, or focus skill.

audioSrc.description: URL or data: URI of the audio clip. Optional if audioBase64 is supplied.

audioBase64.description: Base64-encoded audio payload used to build a data: URI when audioSrc is not provided.

audioMime.description: MIME type for the inline audio payload (default 'audio/mpeg').

duration.description: Fallback clip length in seconds when metadata is unavailable; must be greater than 0.

playLabel.description: Accessible/text label for the play control (default 'Play').

pauseLabel.description: Accessible/text label for the pause control (default 'Pause').

emptyLabel.description: Message shown when no cue segments are provided.

unavailableLabel.description: Message shown when audio cannot be decoded or played in the current browser.

cueNote.description: Optional short teacher note displayed beneath the transcript (e.g. a delivery or pronunciation cue).

waveform.description: Optional normalized amplitude samples (0..1) used to draw the waveform; a procedural wave is drawn if omitted.

cues.description: Time-aligned transcript segments, highlighted in turn as the audio plays.

text.description: The sentence or phrase spoken during this cue.

end.description: Cue end time in seconds (>= start).

Concept_StepLadder.name: Concept StepLadder
Concept_StepLadder.description: Progressive stack where higher-order rules visually sit atop foundational rules.

schema.title: Concept StepLadder
schema.description: Progressive stack of concept steps where higher-order rules visually sit atop foundational rules.

title.description: Ladder heading shown at the top of the block.

subtitle.description: Optional secondary line under the title.

label.description: Optional eyebrow label shown above the title (e.g. 'Foundations of Argument').

foundationalNote.description: Caption shown at the base of the ladder (foundational tier).

higherOrderNote.description: Caption shown at the top of the ladder (higher-order tier).

steps.description: Ordered step list from foundational (index 0) at the bottom to highest-order at the top.

tier.description: Tier tag for the step, e.g. 'Foundation', 'Application', 'Synthesis'.

rule.description: The rule or concept statement that sits on this rung.

detail.description: Optional one- or two-line elaboration of the rule.

example.description: Optional concrete example illustrating the rule.

accent.description: Optional accent color for the step card.

Concept_CautionFlag.name: Concept CautionFlag
Concept_CautionFlag.description: Warning box detailing strict exceptions, non-examples, and illegal rule transfers.

schema.title: Concept CautionFlag
schema.description: Warning box detailing strict exceptions, non-examples, and illegal rule transfers for a concept.

conceptLabel.description: Short name of the concept the cautions apply to (e.g. 'Factoring over the integers').

flagTitle.description: Heading for the caution box. Falls back to a generic heading if omitted.

flagIntro.description: Optional one- or two-sentence framing paragraph shown under the heading.

kind.description: Visual category of the caution; controls the accent and the small tag label.

title.description: Short caution heading, e.g. 'Do NOT cancel summands'.

detail.description: One or two sentences explaining the rule boundary.

wrongExample.description: Optional incorrect symbolic/string example (rendered with a strike/red treatment).

rightExample.description: Optional correct symbolic/string example (rendered with success treatment).

exampleNote.description: Optional caption tying the two examples together.

ruleRef.description: Optional short reference to the rule being bounded, e.g. 'Zero-Product Property'.

footerNote.description: Optional closing line at the bottom of the box.

Concept_AnalogyBridge.name: Concept AnalogyBridge
Concept_AnalogyBridge.description: Split card comparing the abstract academic rule directly to everyday physical objects.

schema.title: Concept AnalogyBridge
schema.description: Split card comparing an abstract academic rule to everyday physical objects.

conceptLabel.description: Short eyebrow label above the concept side (e.g. subject or unit name).

conceptTitle.description: Name of the abstract concept / rule being anchored.

rule.description: The abstract academic rule stated plainly.

ruleDetail.description: Optional supporting sentence expanding the rule.

bridgeStatement.description: Optional one-line bridge sentence displayed on the divider linking both sides.

analogies.description: One or more everyday physical-object analogies, each paired to a facet of the rule.

objectName.description: Concrete physical object name, e.g. 'A car jack'.

everydayScene.description: One or two sentences describing the everyday physical situation.

mapsTo.description: The specific part of the abstract rule this object maps to.

because.description: Why the mapping holds — the shared mechanism.

icon.description: Optional key for one of the built-in line-art icons: lever, spring, funnel, mirror, ramp, gear, container, rope, prism, pump. Unknown or missing keys render a default dot.

Concept_FlowDiagram.name: Concept FlowDiagram

Tool_GlossaryModal.description: Quick-search dictionary overlay searching definitions without leaving the lesson.

schema.title: Tool_GlossaryModal
schema.description: Quick-search glossary overlay: a modal dictionary of lesson terms with instant filtering, opening without leaving the lesson.

title.description: Heading shown at the top of the modal overlay.

subtitle.description: Optional secondary line under the title (e.g. what the glossary covers).

searchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text for the search field. Falls back to a generic placeholder if omitted.

openLabel.description: Accessible label for the floating button that opens the modal.

emptyMessage.description: Message shown when a search matches no terms.

term.description: The glossary headword as it appears in the lesson.

partOfSpeech.description: Optional part of speech or usage label (e.g. 'noun', 'rhetorical strategy').

example.description: Optional example sentence or usage note from the lesson.

related.description: Optional related terms; tapping one jumps the search to that term.

Tool_CaseWorkbench.name: Tool CaseWorkbench
Tool_CaseWorkbench.description: Split-pane layout with source text on the left and an annotation ledger on the right.

schema.title: Tool_CaseWorkbench
schema.description: Split-pane case workbench: source text on the left, annotation ledger on the right. Every line of source text and every annotation is authored data; the block renders and wires them only.

caseTitle.description: Title of the case/source being examined (header of the workbench).

caseSubtitle.description: Short secondary line: author, publication, date, or context.

source.description: Ordered list of paragraphs (or verse/stanza/section blocks) making up the source text shown in the left pane.

id.description: Stable id for the paragraph; used as annotation anchor and for re-render.

label.description: Optional short label shown in the gutter (e.g. '¶1', 'Stanza II', 'Section 3.2').

text.description: Full text of the paragraph. Preserved with line breaks inside a stanza.

annotations.description: Ledger entries referencing spans of the source. Each entry highlights its span in the source pane and lists in the right-hand ledger.

sourceId.description: Id of the source paragraph this annotation points to.

quote.description: Exact substring of the paragraph text to highlight as the annotated span. If not found verbatim, the annotation still lists but highlights nothing.

category.description: Short category tag shown as a chip (e.g. 'Diction', 'Appeal to pathos', 'Claim').

note.description: The analyst's note about the quoted span.

author.description: Optional author of the note (initials or name).

tone.description: Optional accent hint for the chip/highlight: 'success' (green), 'caution' (amber), 'error' (red), 'accent' (default cyan).

emptyLedgerMessage.description: Message shown in the ledger when no annotations are supplied.

footerNote.description: Optional short line pinned at the bottom of the workbench (e.g. assignment reminder or citation).

Tool_FormulaSheet.name: Tool FormulaSheet
Tool_FormulaSheet.description: Slide-over quick reference panel displaying foundational equations.

schema.title: Tool FormulaSheet
schema.description: Slide-over quick reference panel displaying foundational equations. Content arrives entirely through data; the block supplies only the slide-over chrome and interaction.

sheetTitle.description: Heading shown at the top of the slide-over panel.

sheetSubtitle.description: Optional secondary line under the heading, e.g. the unit or exam reference.

triggerLabel.description: Label on the button that opens the panel. Defaults to a short generic label if omitted.

categories.description: Grouped collections of formulas rendered in order.

categoryNote.description: Optional one-line note under the category heading.

name.description: Human name of the relationship, e.g. 'Newton's second law'.

expression.description: The equation itself, plain text with Unicode symbols, e.g. 'F_net = m·a'.

symbolKey.description: Optional legend of symbols used in the expression.

note.description: Optional caution, condition of use, or common pitfall.

Nav_StickyProgress.name: Nav StickyProgress
Nav_StickyProgress.description: Pinned top progress bar showing current lesson position and score accumulation.

schema.title: Nav StickyProgress
schema.description: Pinned top progress bar showing current lesson position and score accumulation.

lessonTitle.description: Short label for the current lesson, shown at the left of the bar.

unitLabel.description: Optional smaller context line (unit, module, or skill) shown beside or under the lesson title.

currentStep.description: 1-based index of the step the learner is currently on.

totalSteps.description: Total number of steps in the lesson.

stepLabels.description: Optional short labels for each step, used in the tooltip/title of each position pip and the aria-labels.

score.description: Points accumulated so far in this lesson.

maxScore.description: Maximum points available in this lesson (used to render the score fraction and meter).

scoreLabel.description: Optional prefix word before the score readout, e.g. 'Score' or 'Points'.

streak.description: Optional current correct-answer streak. Rendered with the caution accent only when greater than zero.

stepStates.description: Optional per-step status overrides: 'complete', 'current', or 'upcoming'. If omitted, states are derived from currentStep.

barColor.description: Optional hex color for the filled portion of the progress bar. Defaults to the primary accent.

Nav_CheckpointJump.name: Nav CheckpointJump
Nav_CheckpointJump.description: Clickable breadcrumb dots allowing jumping back to previously completed sections.

schema.title: Nav CheckpointJump
schema.description: Clickable breadcrumb dots allowing jumping back to previously completed sections of a lesson.

label.description: Accessible label prefix for the navigation region, e.g. 'Lesson checkpoints'.

checkpoints.description: Ordered list of lesson sections; each is one breadcrumb dot.

id.description: Stable unique identifier for the section, echoed back in the jump event.

title.description: Short section name shown in the tooltip and on the success chip.

state.description: completed = clickable and reachable; current = where the learner is now (not clickable); locked = not yet reachable (not clickable).

position.description: Optional progress percentage (0-100) used for the done tick mark on the rail.

context.description: Optional one-line recall cue shown beside the completion chip.

onJump.description: Optional event name to dispatch on the container (detail: {id, index, title, context}) when a completed dot is activated.

allowJumpBack.description: When true, any completed dot is tappable. When false, all dots render static.

reducedMotion.description: Force reduced-motion rendering regardless of user agent preference.

Nav_BranchPath.name: Nav BranchPath
Nav_BranchPath.description: Two-path decision junction allowing the student to choose their learning path forward.

schema.title: Nav Branch Path
schema.description: A two-path decision junction: the student chooses one of two learning paths to continue.

prompt.description: Short instructional line displayed above the two paths, e.g. 'Choose how you want to continue.'

title.description: Path name, e.g. 'Scaffolded Practice'.

subtitle.description: One-line description of what this path contains.

detail.description: Optional short supporting line (duration, item count, difficulty).

icon.description: Optional named icon key: 'steps' (guided), 'flame' (challenge), 'book', 'compass', 'lab', 'quill'. Unknown or missing keys fall back to a neutral node glyph.

badge.description: Optional short badge label, e.g. 'Recommended' or 'Challenge'.

badgeTone.description: Visual tone for the badge: 'success' (green), 'caution' (amber), 'accent' (cyan). Defaults to 'accent'.

disabled.description: Optional: renders the path as unavailable.

onSelectLabel.description: Optional accessible label for the selection action, defaults to 'Begin this path'.

selectedPathId.description: Optional preselected path index as a string ('0' or '1'); normally omitted.

showChosenNotice.description: Whether to display a brief chosen-path confirmation after selection. Defaults to true.

chosenNoticePrefix.description: Optional prefix for the chosen notice, e.g. 'Path selected:'.

eventHook.description: Optional custom event name to dispatch with the chosen path index; defaults to 'navbranch:choose'.

Feedback_ToastSuccess.name: Feedback ToastSuccess
Feedback_ToastSuccess.description: Lightweight sliding notification banner verifying correct input with haptic vibration.

schema.title: Feedback Toast Success
schema.description: Payload for a lightweight sliding success notification banner that verifies correct input and pulses a haptic vibration.

message.description: Short confirmation headline shown in the toast, e.g. 'Correct — thesis identified.'

detail.description: Optional one-line supporting detail rendered beneath the message in secondary text.

eyebrow.description: Optional small uppercase kicker rendered above the message (e.g. 'Close Reading · Q3').

durationMs.description: Auto-dismiss delay in milliseconds. 0 or omitted keeps the toast until dismissed manually. Minimum honored value 1200.

haptic.description: Whether to fire a short navigator.vibrate pulse on show. Defaults to true when omitted.

accent.description: Which status accent to use for the toast's edge and icon. Defaults to 'success'.

position.description: Slide-in origin for the toast. Defaults to 'top'.

showDismiss.description: Whether to render a 40px dismiss button. Defaults to true.

Feedback_ModalDiagnostic.name: Feedback ModalDiagnostic
Feedback_ModalDiagnostic.description: Full overlay breaking down why an answer failed and presenting an analogy.

schema.title: Feedback Modal Diagnostic Payload
schema.description: Content payload for a full-screen diagnostic overlay that explains why an answer failed and presents an analogy.

title.description: Heading shown at the top of the overlay, e.g. 'Why that answer missed'.

subtitle.description: Optional secondary line under the title, e.g. the skill or question stem summary.

attemptLabel.description: Optional label naming the learner's submitted answer, e.g. 'Your answer: 4.9 m'.

diagnosis.description: Breakdown of why the answer failed.

heading.description: Heading for the diagnosis panel, e.g. 'What went wrong'.

reason.description: One-sentence root-cause statement describing the misconception or slip.

points.description: Optional list of specific breakdown bullets (each step of the flawed reasoning).

analogy.description: An analogy that reframes the concept in familiar terms.

heading.description: Heading for the analogy panel, e.g. 'Think of it like this'.

text.description: The analogy narrative itself.

sourceDomain.description: Optional label for the familiar side of the analogy, e.g. 'Everyday life'.

targetDomain.description: Optional label for the concept side of the analogy, e.g. 'Projectile motion'.

bridge.description: Optional one-line mapping statement tying the two domains together.

recovery.description: Optional next-step guidance shown in a footer strip.

heading.description: Heading for the recovery strip, e.g. 'Next time'.

text.description: Concrete procedural advice for retrying this kind of problem.

dismissLabel.description: Optional label for the close button (defaults to 'Got it').

tone.description: Visual accent tone for the overlay header.

State_StreakCelebration.name: State StreakCelebration
State_StreakCelebration.description: Confetti trigger component activating on 5 consecutive correct recall checks.

schema.title: State StreakCelebration Payload
schema.description: Data for a confetti celebration that fires when a learner records 5 consecutive correct recall checks.

streakTarget.description: Number of consecutive correct recall checks required to trigger the celebration. Defaults to 5.

milestoneMessage.description: Headline shown on the celebration banner when the streak is complete.

supportMessage.description: Secondary line shown under the milestone headline.

milestoneBadge.description: Short badge label stamped on the celebration (e.g. '5 in a row').

streakLabel.description: Label describing what each streak pip counts (e.g. 'Correct recall checks').

confettiColors.description: Hex colors used for the confetti burst. Falls back to the app palette if omitted.

checks.description: The recall checks in the lesson sequence, in order. Each contributes one pip to the streak meter.

prompt.description: The recall prompt text the learner sees.

answer.description: The expected answer for the check (data only; not scored by this block).

unitLabel.description: Optional short unit/context tag shown on the check card.

skillTag.description: Optional skill tag for the check.

State_ReviewLocker.name: State ReviewLocker
State_ReviewLocker.description: End-of-lesson card holding all missed questions for review before concluding.

schema.title: State ReviewLocker Payload
schema.description: End-of-lesson card listing every missed question for review before the learner concludes the lesson.

cardTitle.description: Heading shown at the top of the review card. Defaults to a neutral title if omitted.

cardSubtitle.description: One-line secondary summary shown under the title, e.g. lesson name or skill tag.

missedQuestions.description: All questions missed during the lesson, in the order they should be reviewed.

prompt.description: The question stem the learner saw.

learnerAnswer.description: The answer the learner submitted (shown struck-through as a misconception).

correctAnswer.description: The correct answer, shown as the corrected takeaway.

skillTag.description: Short skill/standard label, e.g. 'Rhetorical Analysis — Anaphora'.

reviewed.description: Whether the learner has already marked this item reviewed; seeds initial state.

concludeLabel.description: Label for the conclude button. Defaults to 'Conclude Lesson'.

summaryLine.description: Optional closing line rendered once every item is reviewed (e.g. 'All 3 reviewed — nice recovery.')

emptyMessage.description: Message shown when missedQuestions is empty. Defaults to a clean-slate notice.

Action_ShareCard.name: Action ShareCard
Action_ShareCard.description: Generates a shareable visual badge summarizing lesson score and mastery level.

schema.title: Action ShareCard
schema.description: Generates a shareable visual badge summarizing lesson score and mastery level.

lessonTitle.description: Title of the lesson the badge summarizes.

studentName.description: Optional learner name shown on the badge. Omit for an anonymous badge.

masteryTier.description: Optional tone hint for the mastery color.

tagline.description: Optional one-line takeaway printed on the badge.

statLabel.description: Optional label for the secondary stat (e.g. 'Concepts mastered').

statValue.description: Optional value for the secondary stat.

shareText.description: Optional default text copied to the clipboard / shared with the Web Share API.

dateLabel.description: Optional date or term string shown in the badge footer.

credentialId.description: Optional short credential or badge ID shown small in the footer.

downloadName.description: Optional base filename for the downloaded PNG (without extension).

Action_LessonComplete.name: Action LessonComplete
Action_LessonComplete.description: Full-width primary CTA button locking the score, logging progress, and advancing to the next level.

schema.title: Action_LessonComplete
schema.description: Data payload for a full-width primary CTA that locks the score, logs progress, and advances to the next level.

label.description: Primary button label, e.g. 'Complete Lesson & Continue'.

ariaLabel.description: Accessible name for the button if the visible label is abbreviated. Falls back to label.

scoreLabel.description: Short caption shown above/left of the score, e.g. 'Session score'.

scoreValue.description: The score that will be locked on tap (numeric or pre-formatted string).

scoreMax.description: Maximum possible score; rendered as '/ max' when present.

scoreUnit.description: Optional unit or suffix rendered after the score, e.g. 'pts'.

progressLabel.description: Caption for the progress bar, e.g. 'Course progress'.

progressCompleteValue.description: Percentage 0-100 the bar animates to after the lesson is completed. Defaults to progressValue + 100/chapters, capped at 100.

progressSteps.description: Optional step counter shown next to the progress label, e.g. '4 / 12'.

nextLevelLabel.description: Caption for the upcoming level, e.g. 'Next level'.

nextLevelTitle.description: Title of the level the learner advances to.

nextLevelSubtitle.description: One-line teaser for the next level.

lockedNote.description: Short reassurance rendered under the button before/while completing, e.g. 'Your score is saved to this device.'

completedHeading.description: Heading swapped in after the action fires, e.g. 'Score locked.'

completedBody.description: Body line confirming progress was logged and the next level is ready.

streakValue.description: Optional streak number shown as a caution-accented badge.

onComplete.description: Optional callback invoked with {scoreValue, scoreMax, progressValue} when the action fires. Ignored if not a function.
